_note: SLIP publishes prompt banks only for TCGA lung, DHMC, and PatchGastricADC22. This benchmark-authored task extension is stored in a legacy 'Name: description' notation. The declared separator makes the loader expand every row losslessly to [short name, description], preserving SLIP's two-text averaging semantics. It is not an upstream prompt-faithful condition.
tissues: Lymph node cortex: Outer nodal region containing densely packed follicles.
Germinal centre: Pale reactive follicle centre with proliferating B lymphocytes.
Subcapsular sinus: Space beneath the capsule where afferent lymphatics drain.
Medullary cords: Cords of lymphocytes and plasma cells between medullary sinuses.
Nodal capsule: Dense fibrous tissue enclosing the lymph node.
Metastatic tumour cells: Cohesive epithelial cells foreign to nodal architecture.
Adipose tissue: Perinodal fat surrounding the capsule.
Tumor nests: Clusters of cancerous cells forming distinct groups separated by stroma.
Solid tumor: A solid sheet of cancer cells with little intervening architecture.
Stroma: Supporting connective tissue between tumour and normal structures.
Necrosis: Areas of dead cells with loss of nuclear detail and granular debris.
Inflammatory infiltrate: Immune cells scattered through tissue in response to injury or tumour.
Vascular invasion: Tumour cells within the lumen of a blood or lymphatic vessel.
Fibrosis: Dense collagen deposition replacing normal tissue architecture.
Pleomorphism: Marked variation in nuclear size, shape and staining between tumour cells.
Lymphocytic infiltration: Dense aggregates of small mature lymphocytes.
Hyalinization: Homogeneous glassy eosinophilic material replacing stroma.
